subject: Interim Superintendent Appointment
overview: The School Committee met to select an interim leader for the district to ensure continuity during upcoming budget and facility projects. The Committee appointed Assistant Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi to the role.

items.title: Discussion of Interim Leadership Requirements
items.summary: Members discussed the importance of continuity and specific leadership qualities needed to manage ongoing contract negotiations, budget cycles, and school building projects.

items.title: Appointment of Interim Superintendent
items.summary: Appointed Assistant Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi as Interim Superintendent effective January 18, 2025, through June 30, 2026, contingent on successful contract negotiations.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss contract negotiations with no intent to reconvene in public session.
